answer: No vote rides free. Each identity roots one vine in the tundra roll, one vine per key, and each ballot burns 14 POA into the ocean pot, receipt tied to the vine. Each epoch the roll drifts a fresh nonce; the vine's key signs it back within 60 seconds. Lottery tide-auditors replay one vine in six per epoch, re-checking fee and echo. A late, stale, or shared echo voids the ballot, benches the key two epochs; the 14 POA burns either way. N fakes × 14 POA per ballot = 14N burned. Limit: honest keys burn the same 14.
